mapper.select: SELECT id, email, full_name, password_hash, auth_provider, bio, avatar_url, avatar_storage_key, avatar_bucket_name, avatar_content_type, avatar_byte_size, account_status, deletion_requested_at, deletion_scheduled_at, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM app_users WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.email, u.full_name, u.password_hash, u.auth_provider, u.bio, u.avatar_url, u.avatar_storage_key, u.avatar_bucket_name, u.avatar_content_type, u.avatar_byte_size, u.account_status, u.deletion_requested_at, u.deletion_scheduled_at, u.deleted_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user_social_identities usi JOIN app_users u ON u.id = usi.user_id WHERE usi.provider = #{provider} AND usi.provider_subject = #{providerSubject} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_users ( id, email, full_name, password_hash, auth_provider, avatar_url ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{email}, #{fullName}, #{passwordHash}, #{authProvider}, #{avatarUrl} )
